body:
User just submitted this: https://dl.dropbox.com/u/27770548/BungeeCord-2013-03-19%281%29.snapshot
@trustin @normanmaurer as you can see right at the end, ALL worker threads deadlock on the creation + connection of a new Bootstrap. The Netty API should definitely be handling this, as I don''t think my apps code is bad.

Also the code where I create said Bootstrap that they all deadlock on: https://github.com/ElasticPortalSuite/BungeeCord/blob/master/proxy/src/main/java/net/md_5/bungee/UserConnection.java#L116

Sorry about the messy code there.

EDIT: And the line of code where Netty deadlocks: https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/master/transport/src/main/java/io/netty/bootstrap/Bootstrap.java#L189
I'm guessing you need to look there, since I'm using the API 100% correct, so the issue is many bootstraps connecting to the same event loop can deadlock.
@md-5 forgot it for now .. there is something wrong that I need to fix first.

@md-5 ok I think I'm almost done with my fix but it need some more love. I will finish it tomorrow.

There is some problem with multiple fireChannelActive() calls but it is not really specific to the patch I made. It only shows up here.

issue.title: Nobody can connect after some time.

repository.name: BungeeCord
repository.description: BungeeCord, the 6th in a generation of server portal suites. Efficiently proxies and maintains connections and transport between multiple Minecraft servers.

issue.body:
Bungee build 224+ (with 1.5 support)
Tried on builds 273 and 269 with "java -jar BungeeCord.jar"
No Bungee plugins installed.

X players (Sometimes it's ~25, sometimes it's ~60, and sometimes it's ~150) can connect. But after this Bungee would drop all connections. In console there would be no new info about connections. In server list Bungee would be just offline. Bungee console is still respond to commands like "bungee" and "glist". Haven't got this problem at 224, but any upper build which I tried to  run...

java version "1.7.0_17"
Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.7.0_17-b02)
Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 23.7-b01, mixed mode)

Dedicated server on Ubuntu 11.10 (GNU/Linux 3.0.0-12-server x86_64) with 3930k and 64 GB of ram. 
Any other info I could add?

body: Fixed.  Thanks @md-5 for being very helpful.
